title: Federal Lottery 6103-4 Results: Winning Tickets
subtitle: Contest 6103-4 took place on Wednesday (23), offering a R$ 500,000 prize.
excerpt: On Wednesday (23), Caixa Econômica Federal held the Federal Lottery contest 6103-4 drawing.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Estadão, Diário do Nordeste, Banda B
contentHtml:
On Wednesday (23), Caixa Econômica Federal held the Federal Lottery contest 6103-4 drawing, broadcast live on the institution's official YouTube channel. The event, which took place around 8 PM, revealed the five winning tickets and the prize amounts paid in each tier.

How the Federal Lottery Drawing Works

In the Federal Lottery, players purchase a pre-numbered ticket, which can be acquired whole or in fractions. Players do not select numbers, as the results are determined by the five tickets drawn in each extraction.

The main prizes are awarded to the holders of the five drawn tickets, according to the prize order. Additionally, there are derivative prizes for tickets matching the thousands, hundreds, tens, approximations, and other combinations close to the first prize.

Details of Contest 6103-4

The main prize for contest 6103-4 is R$ 500 thousand. The Federal Lottery has four drawing modalities: Quartou (held every Wednesday); Sunday Drawing (on Sundays); Enricou (a special monthly drawing); and the Christmas Special (an annual drawing in December). In regular modalities, such as Quartou and Sunday Drawing, prizes totaling more than R$ 1.5 million are distributed between the main prize and derivative prizes.

Results of the Five Drawings

  1. 1st Drawing: 4 - 0 - 2 - 9 - 2
  2. 2nd Drawing: 5 - 3 - 0 - 8 - 1
  3. 3rd Drawing: 6 - 5 - 5 - 7 - 8
  4. 4th Drawing: 4 - 2 - 3 - 0 - 4
  5. 5th Drawing: 6 - 5 - 8 - 3 - 7

How to Claim the Prize

Prizes can be claimed at lottery retailers for net amounts up to R$ 2,259.20 or at Caixa branches for larger amounts, always respecting the 90-day deadline after the drawing. Winners have up to 90 calendar days from the drawing date to claim the prize, a deadline that cannot be extended.

Next Federal Lottery Drawing

The next drawing, contest 6104, will be on Thursday (24), starting at 9 PM. Tickets cost from R$ 40 and are sold until the time of each drawing, or until the deadline set by lottery retailers.

How to Check if Your Ticket Won

To check if your Federal Lottery ticket has won, simply compare your fraction number with the official results on the Caixa Lotteries website or app. In addition to matching the exact five digits in the five main prizes, you also win if you match the final thousands, hundreds, or tens of any of them, as well as approximations (numbers neighboring the 1st prize).
